lastCompletedStory.title: Drop session_id from state-file readers and inert references

nextStoryContext: US-002 removed session_id from the LoopState type, parseStateFile() copy-block, and header comments in status.ts and resume.ts. The typeof-guard copy pattern in parseStateFile() naturally achieves back-compat for old state files. The codebase no longer has any session_id references in the reader path.
